user.title: Choose a Hue bridge
user.description: Pick the bridge that controls your entertainment area.

manual.title: Enter the bridge address
manual.description: The IP address or hostname of your Hue bridge. You can find it in the Hue app under Settings → My Hue system → Bridge.

link.title: Press the link button
link.description: Press the round link button on top of **{name}** ({host}), then select **Submit** within 30 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge. Check the address and that it is on the same network.
error.link_button_not_pressed: The link button was not pressed. Press it and try again within 30 seconds.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.
abort.not_hue_bridge: This device is not a Hue bridge.

set_colors.name: Set colours
set_colors.description: Set colours per channel (a light or light segment) and/or for the whole entertainment area. Starts sync if it is off. Replaces a running scene, unless Overlay is on. Channel ids are listed in the light's channels attribute.

channels.name: Channels
channels.description: Colour per channel id, as [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, brightness] (0-255), or "#rrggbb" / "#rrggbbBB". Channels not listed keep their colour.

all.name: All channels
all.description: Colour for every channel, applied before Channels. Also becomes the light's colour.

brightness_pct.name: Brightness
brightness_pct.description: Brightness of the whole area in percent.

overlay.name: Overlay
overlay.description: Draw these colours on top of the running scene instead of replacing it.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Remove the overlay after this many seconds. Without it, the overlay stays until cleared or the scene stops.

play_scene.name: Play scene
play_scene.description: Play an animated scene, optionally with its own parameters. Starts sync if it is off.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Scene id or name, for example sweep, aurora or thunderstorm.

params.name: Parameters
params.description: Scene parameters, for example {"color": "#0050ff"}. Others keep their defaults.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: Speed multiplier; also sets the Scene speed slider.

stop_scene.name: Stop scene
stop_scene.description: Stop the animated scene. The lights keep its last frame and sync stays on.
